title: Revenue splits Parts and Labor as whole numbers, with a fallback
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the build under test with a single workplace selected (Reports permission + Dashboard feature on). Numeric-accuracy case (Rule 116): seed the exact records through the app so the correct answer is known and can be computed by hand (Rule 14), then read the figure back and compare to the stated precision - never eyeball.
  2. Seed through the app: a range with known parts and labour totals; and a range with no parts-vs-labour split.
custom_steps:
1. Compute parts% and labor% from the range.
2. Read the Revenue supporting line in each range.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The supporting line reads 'Parts {parts}% · Labor {labor}%' with each percent a whole number matching the computed split.
  • Where there is no parts-vs-labor split, the supporting line reads '{count} Invoices' instead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section(s) S4; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R3: “The Revenue tile shows a supporting line reading "Parts {parts}% · Labor {labor}%", each percent shown as a whole number.”
  • S4-N2: “If the Revenue tile has no parts-versus-labor split to show, its supporting line reads "{count} Invoices" instead.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
